nodes.text: #251 : [Er58b] [ErGr80,p.62] [Er88c,p.103] number theory | irrationality Erdős [Er58b] proved that $\sum \frac{p_n^k}{n!}$ is irrational for every $k\geq 1$. In [Er88c] he further conjectures that $\sum \frac{p_n^k}{2^n}$ is irrational for every $k$, and that if $g_n\geq 2$ and $g_n=o(p_n)$ then\[\sum_{n=1}^\infty \frac{p_n}{g_1\cdots g_n}\]is irrational. (The example $g_n=p_n+1$ shows that some condition on the growth of the $g_n$ is necessary here.) The decimal expansion of this sum is A098990 on the OEIS.
